works.author: Mahmudul Hasan Manik
works.comment: 阿拉伯语 RTL 订单管理仪表盘 Orderze：产品、客户、转化率、收入四张数据卡配世界地图订单分布，绿色点缀提亮浅色界面；电商 SaaS 用“四张数字卡 + 一张世界地图”把店铺运转收进一屏，RTL 排版也值得借鉴。
works.comment_en: Orderze, an Arabic RTL order-management dashboard: four stat cards — products, customers, conversion, revenue — above a world map of orders by country, green accents lifting the light interface; four numbers and one map fit a whole store into a single screen, and the RTL layout is worth studying too.
works.title: Orderze - AI Powered Order Management SaaS Dashboard UI Design

works.author: George Railean
works.comment: 深色 AI 智能体舰队可观测仪表盘：Agent operations 标题下 2,847 个智能体在线、今日花费 $7,412，节点连线图把整支舰队画成一张发光的网；运维工具用“一张网 + 两个大数字”让几千个智能体的状态一眼可读。
works.comment_en: A dark observability dashboard for an AI agent fleet: “Agent operations” over 2,847 agents online and $7,412 spent today, a glowing node-and-line graph turning the whole fleet into one web; one network map and two big numbers make thousands of agents readable at a glance.
works.title: AI Agent Fleet Management - Observability Dashboard UI

works.author: Layo
works.comment: 紫色 AI 创意平台 Vela：Turn scattered ideas into creative direction. 一句口号配手机端工作台，右侧 Campaign Direction A 置信度 92%、下方 NOVA 看板柱状图；AI 创意工具用“一句口号 + 一个置信度”把灵感变成可执行的方向。
works.comment_en: Vela, a purple AI creative platform: “Turn scattered ideas into creative direction.” headlines a phone workspace, with Campaign Direction A at 92% confidence and a NOVA board bar chart below; one slogan and one confidence score turn scattered inspiration into a direction a team can run with.
works.title: Vela AI platform

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: AI 生活助手 App：三屏手机并排——绿色光球配旅行、食谱、学习、健身四类入口，右侧首尔三日行程对话把行程拆成 Day 1–3；日常助手用“一个光球 + 一段对话”把“今天干什么”答得清清楚楚。
works.comment_en: An AI everyday-life assistant app: three phone screens side by side — a green orb with Travel, Recipes, Learning and Fitness entries, and a Seoul three-day itinerary chat broken into Day 1–3; one glowing orb and one conversation answer “what should I do today” with total clarity.
works.title: AI Chatbot - Mobile Assistant

works.author: Awe Mobile App
works.comment: 深紫色加密钱包 App：€15,892.45 大余额配绿色走势曲线，中间 Transfer / Exchange / Deposit / Buy 四个按钮，下方 USDC、LINK、Cardano 持仓一字排开；金融 App 用“一个大数字 + 一条曲线”把资产涨跌讲得干净利落。
works.comment_en: A dark-purple crypto wallet app: a €15,892.45 balance over a green trend curve, Transfer / Exchange / Deposit / Buy in one row, and USDC, LINK and Cardano holdings below; one big number and one curve make a portfolio’s ups and downs clean and immediate.
works.title: Cryptocurrency Wallet & Exchange App

works.author: Deividas Bielskis
works.comment: 徒步 App 着陆页 Monta：浅蓝等高线地图打底，Every trail. Every summit. In your pocket. 大标题镇场，手机上 Eagle Ridge Loop 路线配离线模式开关；户外产品用“一张地形图 + 一部手机”把“没信号也能走”讲得明明白白。
works.comment_en: Monta, a hiking app landing page: a pale-blue topographic map under “Every trail. Every summit. In your pocket.”, with a phone showing the Eagle Ridge Loop route and an offline-mode toggle; one terrain map and one phone make “it works with no signal” perfectly clear.
works.title: Monta Logo & Landing Page for a Hiking App

works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 个人成长 Web App：紫粉渐变上 Olivia Vanderford 的剪影侧脸，左下情绪气泡（78% surprise、54% coolness）围着一朵 Analytical / Leadership / Empathy / Creative 四瓣花，右下便利贴配输入框；成长工具用“一朵特质花 + 一组情绪气泡”把自我认知画得直观又温柔。
works.comment_en: A personal growth web app: Olivia Vanderford’s silhouette in profile on a violet-pink gradient, emotion bubbles (78% surprise, 54% coolness) around a four-petal flower of Analytical, Leadership, Empathy and Creative, with sticky notes and an input box below; one trait flower and one set of emotion bubbles make self-knowledge feel visual and gentle.
works.title: Personal Growth Web App Design
